title: Croatian Dough Dumplings
description: Comforting Croatian dish featuring fermented dough and a sweet touch, made with ground sugar and folded to create a bouncy texture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add the egg and salt to the dough and mix until a sticky ball forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a large pot of boiling salted water.
Once the water is boiling, use a spoon to drop small pieces of the risen dough into the water.
Cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Use a slotted spoon to remove the cooked dumplings from the water and serve hot.
